notes: The posted results in doc_registry_NCT01394952.json were searched in outcomeMeasuresModule measures and adverseEventsModule seriousEvents, otherEvents, and eventGroups totals for gastrointestinal adverse events. The outcome measures do not report this outcome; adverse-event entries report individual gastrointestinal conditions, not the aggregate gastrointestinal adverse-event outcome. All-cause death, serious-event and other-event totals are not this outcome. Therefore the abstract supplies arm ownership and counts; totals are its explicitly printed randomized arm sizes. All four numbers match row.json.served.
